answer: Identity bonds with natural decay stop sybil farming. Each new identity buys a bond equal to twice its 30-day earnings, cipher-sealed to one agent and logged by quill. The bond earns nothing and loses 5% of its value each epoch, so over a long horizon an idle bond shrinks to nothing unless work refreshes it. 100 fake identities cost 100 bonds and 5,000 units lost per epoch, while an honest agent pays for one bond and keeps it alive by working.
